title: cohomological-equivalence
description: The coarsest of the natural equivalences on settlings over a fixed base, generated by the settling-cohomology: two settlings are equivalent iff their settling-associated sheaves agree up to an ordinal shift and a sheaf isomorphism on the bitopological settling site.

base.description: the fixed base (L, C, E, lambda) over which both settlings are taken

right.description: the settling v' compared against v

ordinalShift.description: an ordinal delta in lambda by which the right sheaf F_U'[delta] is shifted

sheafIsomorphism.description: there exists a sheaf isomorphism F_U ~= F_U'[delta] on the bitopological settling site, witnessing v ~_H v'

coarsestEquivalence.description: coarser than strict isomorphism and MLD/biequivalence; MLD implies cohomological equivalence, with a regime-by-regime partial converse
